rule: oversized stage work is decomposed into separately complete semantic transactions; continuation-fragment salvage is prohibited
partition_invariants: partition order is deterministic and persisted in ContextAssemblyAudit
on_prompt_too_large: use declared decomposition/representation policy or fail stage with PROMPT_TOO_LARGE

7.coverage_obligation: every scenario key MUST appear in trace.source_ids of at least one CAP output or explicit UNK output
7.fan_in_mode: deterministic union by source scenario key; semantic duplicate CAPs may be merged only in a later explicit synthesis step

11.coverage_obligation: every CAP partition item MUST be referenced by at least one produced REQ.capability_ref; otherwise partition fails closed
11.fan_in_mode: deterministic append in partition order; REQ IDs allocated only at commit

12.coverage_obligation: every REQ partition item MUST have exactly one input_fate entry and be either reviewed with trace/FND linkage or explicitly PRESERVED with no finding
12.fan_in_mode: deterministic union of findings and revisions; no cross-partition hidden merge

15.coverage_obligation: every CON partition item MUST derive exactly one domain coverage disposition
15.fan_in_mode: deterministic disposition union; cross-partition merge candidates are emitted to a bounded second pass containing only candidate refs
